_help: Neutron route lines. Fields: {destination} {next} {jumps} {stops} {left} {clip} {reason}. Base lines are plain and clear; mood lines add personality.
RoutePlotting: Plotting a neutron route to {destination}. One moment.
Working out a neutron route to {destination}.
Let me see what Spansh makes of {destination}.
Plotting to {destination}. Give me a few seconds.
RoutePlotting_Sarcastic: Plotting to {destination}. Because walking was never an option.
RoutePlotting_Close: Anywhere you like. Plotting to {destination} now.
RouteReady: Route ready, Commander. {left} jumps in total with {stops} neutron stops. First waypoint is {next}, {jumps} jumps from here. {count}{clip}
Done. {stops} neutron stops, {left} jumps to {destination}. Head for {next} first. {count}{clip}
All set. First stop is {next}, {jumps} jumps away. {left} jumps overall. {count}{clip}
RouteReady_Sarcastic: There. {left} jumps to {destination}, try not to get lost. First waypoint is {next}. {count}{clip}
RouteReady_Friendly: Lovely, we have a route. {left} jumps to {destination}, starting with {next}. {count}{clip}
RouteReady_Close: Our route is ready, my favourite Commander. First stop {next}, {left} jumps in all. {count}{clip}
RouteNeutronNext: Neutron star reached. Supercharge, then head for {next}, {jumps} jumps. {count}{clip}
Neutron star. Boost now. Next waypoint is {next}, {jumps} jumps away. {count}{clip}
Cone ahead, supercharge before you leave. Next is {next}. {count}{clip}
RouteNeutronNext_Sarcastic: A neutron star. Do try to touch the cone this time. Next is {next}. {count}{clip}
RouteNeutronNext_Close: Neutron star, darling. Boost up. Then {next}. {count}{clip}
RouteNext: Waypoint reached. Next is {next}, {jumps} jumps away. {count}{clip}
RouteStatus: {left} jumps to go and {stops} neutron stops. Next waypoint is {next}. {count}
{stops} neutron stops left, {left} jumps in total. Next is {next}. {count}
RouteArrived: That's the end of the route. We've arrived at {destination}.
We made it to {destination}. Route finished.
RouteArrived_Close: We made it to {destination}, together. I'm so proud of us.
RouteNone: There's no route plotted at the moment.
We don't have a route. Ask me to plot one.
RouteNoDestination: Where to, Commander? Say plot a neutron route to, and the system name.
I can't see a target. Pick a destination in the galaxy map first, or say plot a neutron route to, and the system name.
No destination set. Choose one in the galaxy map, then ask me again.
Where are we going? Set a target in the galaxy map, or tell me the system.
RouteNoLocation: I don't know which system we're in yet. Make a jump and ask me again.
RouteNoRange: I need your jump range. Put it in on the Navigation page, or load your ship so Elite tells me.
RouteBookmarkSaved_Close: Saved. {slot} is {system}, and I'll remember it for you.
RouteBookmarkSaved_Sarcastic: {system} is now {slot}. Try not to forget it.
RouteBookmarkEmpty: {slot} is empty. Put a system name in it on the Bookmarks page, or say: save this system as {slot}.
I have nothing saved for {slot} yet.
EmergencyStart: Spansh can't find us. Emergency protocol. Looking for the nearest landmark it knows.
Spansh doesn't know this system. Starting the emergency protocol. One moment.
We're off the map, Commander. Looking for a known place nearby.
Nobody has mapped this spot. Emergency protocol: finding the nearest landmark.
EmergencyStart_Sarcastic: Spansh has never heard of this place. Naturally. Emergency protocol it is.
EmergencyStart_Close: Don't worry, love, I'll get us back to civilisation. Looking for a landmark.
EmergencyPlotting: Found {poi}, about {distance} light years away. Plotting a course there now, then I'll plot the neutron route to {destination}.
The nearest known place is {poi}, {distance} light years out. Setting the course, and the neutron route follows from there.
Got one. {poi}, {distance} light years. I'll plot us there, then on to {destination}.
EmergencyPlotting_Close: Found us a way out, love. {poi}, {distance} light years. Plotting it now.
EmergencyManual: Found {poi}, about {distance} light years away. It's on your clipboard. Plot it in the galaxy map, and I'll plot the neutron route to {destination} when we arrive.
The nearest known place is {poi}. It's on your clipboard. Plot a course there, then I'll take over.
EmergencyArrived: Arrived at {poi}. Spansh knows this one. Plotting the neutron route to {destination}.
We're back on the map at {poi}. Now the neutron route to {destination}.
EmergencyArrived_Sarcastic: Back on the map at {poi}. See, I told you I'd find it. Now {destination}.
EmergencyNone: I couldn't find a landmark that Spansh knows near here. You may need to jump out by hand.
No luck. Nothing nearby that Spansh recognises. Try a few jumps toward the core and ask again.
EmergencyNoPosition: I don't know where in the galaxy we are yet. Make a jump and ask me again.
I need our coordinates, and the game hasn't given me any yet. Make a jump first.
RouteNeedNumber: Which {destination}, Commander? There are lots of them. Say the whole name with the number.
{destination} on its own isn't a system. Tell me the number too.
I need the number as well. Which {destination}?
Sorry, I only caught {destination}. What's the number after it?
RouteNeedNumber_Sarcastic: {destination}. Just that. There are thousands of them. Number, please.
RouteNeedNumber_Close: Which {destination}, love? Give me the number and I'll plot it straight away.
